tokens.name: ae-white
tokens.usage: Pure white. Light page background, text on dark fills, white logo variants.

tokens.name: ae-black
tokens.usage: Pure black. Only as the background of the black logo variant; never for UI text (use `ae-text`).

tokens.name: ae-bg
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: ae-bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Alternate sections, panels, table header rows, sidebar. The Blue Book's grey panel.

tokens.name: ae-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, table bodies.

tokens.name: ae-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, modals, toasts: anything floating (pair with a shadow).

tokens.name: ae-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the mobile navigation drawer.

tokens.name: ae-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, card outlines. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ae-border-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries (inputs, checkboxes, radios, switches, secondary buttons). At least 3:1 on `ae-bg`, `ae-bg-subtle`, `ae-surface` and `ae-surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ae-text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `ae-bg`, `ae-bg-subtle`, `ae-surface`, `ae-surface-raised` and every `*-soft` tint.

tokens.name: ae-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, metadata, placeholders. AA on `ae-bg`, `ae-bg-subtle`, `ae-surface` and `ae-surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ae-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and values only (WCAG exempts disabled controls). Never for readable content.

tokens.name: ae-neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral solid fill: neutral badges and status dots (draft, archived, not started).

tokens.name: ae-on-neutral
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ae-neutral`.

tokens.name: ae-brand
tokens.usage: AIESEC Blue in both themes: hero bands, watermark tabs, logo tiles, brand moments, display headings (24px+ only). Not for small text or buttons (use `ae-primary`).

tokens.name: ae-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ae-brand`: large text (24px+, or 19px+ bold), icons and logos only (3.98:1).

tokens.name: ae-primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (buttons), selected controls (checkbox, radio, switch, tab indicator, pagination), progress fills. AA with `ae-on-primary`; 3:1 or more against every surface.

tokens.name: ae-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `ae-primary` fills.

tokens.name: ae-primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed state of `ae-primary` fills.

tokens.name: ae-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ae-primary`, `ae-primary-hover` and `ae-primary-active`.

tokens.name: ae-primary-text
tokens.usage: Links, tertiary and ghost button labels, active navigation items: text in AIESEC Blue at any size. AA on every surface and on `ae-primary-soft`.

tokens.name: ae-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav item background, soft buttons, info alert background.

tokens.name: ae-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid outline, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ae-info
tokens.usage: Info status fill. Alias of `ae-primary`: information is AIESEC Blue.

tokens.name: ae-on-info

tokens.name: ae-info-text

tokens.name: ae-info-soft
tokens.usage: Info alert and badge background.

tokens.name: ae-success

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

groups.name: Headlines
groups.note: The display family: Lato, the brand font, unless a platform with its own identity sets a personality font in --font-display. Display and H1 follow the Blue Book headline: a Light or Regular lead-in with the keyword in <strong> (Black 900). H2 to H4 are Bold.

styles.name: ae-display
styles.usage: Hero titles, one per page; keyword in <strong>. 40px under 640px.

styles.name: ae-h1
styles.usage: Page titles, one per page; keyword in <strong>. 32px under 640px.

groups.name: Text
